newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Ireland Blyth 1996 interim profit slumps.
newsitem.headline: Ireland Blyth 1996 interim profit slumps.

text.p: Ireland Blyth Limited (IBL), the second largest conglomerate in Mauritius, made profits of 8.65 million rupees ($427,500) in the first nine months of 1996, 75 percent down on 34.64 million in the same period of 1995, company officials said on Wednesday.
For the nine-month period, turnover was 8.7 percent higher at 2.201 billion rupees in 1996 from 2.024 billion in 1995.
Profit attributable to shareholders fell to 960,000 rupees for the nine months ending 30 September 1996, from 29.34 million rupees for the corresponding period in 1995.
In August, Ireland Blyth reported a 40 percent slump in profit for the first six months to 25.44 million rupees.
Company officials then blamed difficult trading conditions in the local commercial sector for the results and forecast results for the whole year 1996 to be the same as in 1995.
IBL reported pre-tax profit of 50.3 million rupees for the whole year 1995, turnover of 2.85 billion rupees and profit attributable to shareholders of 32.1 million rupees.
